title: BB-8
description: Astromed Droid BB-8 was Poe Dameron's sidekick and flying partner. After Poe was captured by Kylo Ren, BB-8 escaped and made the acquaintance of Rey and Finn. BB-8 flew with Poe Dameron during the Battle of Starkiller Base. A reactivated R2-D2 combined his star map with the fragment that BB-8 obtained on Jakku, completing a way to find Luke Skywalker.
